name: Pathfinder
description: Searches a classic level for inputs that beat it and exports them as a .gdr macro

toggle_pathfinder.name: Start / stop
toggle_pathfinder.description: Starts or stops the search in the current level.

search_window.name: Search window (ticks)
search_window.description: How far before a death (at 240 ticks per second) the bot tries a new click or release. Raise it for levels where the cause of a death is far earlier.

search_step.name: Tick step
search_step.description: Try every Nth tick inside the window. 1 is frame-perfect; 2-3 is faster on easy parts.

dedupe_deaths.name: Skip identical deaths
dedupe_deaths.description: Don't explore a new input if it dies at exactly the same tick and place as an input already tried. Much faster; turn off if the search gives up on a level it should beat.

exact_mode.name: Exact mode (slow)
exact_mode.description: Rewind by restarting the level and replaying inputs instead of loading snapshots. Every try is bit-exact, but long levels get very slow.

frame_budget_ms.name: Time per frame (ms)
frame_budget_ms.description: How long the search runs each rendered frame. Higher is faster but the game gets choppy.

snapshot_interval.name: Snapshot every N ticks
snapshot_interval.description: Smaller rewinds faster but uses more memory.

max_snapshots.name: Max snapshots
max_snapshots.description: Older snapshots are thinned out past this count.

max_repairs.name: Max repairs
max_repairs.description: Each found path is replayed from a clean start. If it drifts and dies, the bot searches again from there, up to this many times.

export_folder.name: Save location
export_folder.description: Same default as xdBot's macro folder, so found paths show up in its Load menu.

export_json.name: Save as .gdr.json
export_json.description: Write JSON instead of the usual MessagePack .gdr.

seed.name: RNG seed
seed.description: Seed for random triggers during the search, stored in the .gdr. Your replay bot must use the same seed on levels with random triggers.
